name: google-services-mcps
description: One plugin per Google product. Install the products you need, then turn each server on or off for a session with /mcp.

plugins.name: gcloud
plugins.description: Google Cloud console APIs: projects, service enablement, API keys, billing, monitoring, storage, BigQuery and IAM, plus the rest of the infrastructure, data, devops, networking, security and governance APIs.

plugins.name: gsc
plugins.description: Search Console sites, sitemaps, search analytics, URL indexing and site verification.

plugins.name: gsearch
plugins.description: Public search and web-quality APIs (Custom Search, PageSpeed, CrUX, Safe Browsing, Web Risk, Fact Check) that take an API key instead of OAuth. The Custom Search JSON API is closed to new customers and is scheduled to be discontinued on 2027-01-01.

plugins.name: gdrive
plugins.description: Google Drive files, labels and activity, plus Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms and Books.

plugins.name: gmail
plugins.description: Gmail mailboxes, messages, labels and settings, plus Gmail Postmaster Tools.

plugins.name: gcalendar
plugins.description: Google Calendar calendars, events and calendar settings.

plugins.name: gchat
plugins.description: Google Chat spaces, messages and members, plus Workspace Events subscriptions.

plugins.name: gmeet
plugins.description: Google Meet spaces, conference records, participants and recordings.

plugins.name: gcontacts
plugins.description: Google Contacts and People, personal health metrics, Data Portability, and the OAuth2 userinfo endpoints.

plugins.name: gtasks
plugins.description: Google Tasks task lists and tasks, plus Google Keep notes.

plugins.name: gclassroom
plugins.description: Google Classroom courses, coursework, submissions, students and teachers.

plugins.name: gapps
plugins.description: Apps Script projects and execution, plus the Workspace Marketplace SDK.

plugins.name: gadmin
plugins.description: Google Workspace administration: Cloud Identity, Chrome management and policy, Groups Settings, licensing, reports, alerts, Vault, reseller and Cloud Search admin.

plugins.name: ganalytics
plugins.description: Google Analytics admin and data APIs for GA4 properties, configuration and reports.

plugins.name: gtm
plugins.description: Google Tag Manager accounts, containers, tags, triggers and variables.

plugins.name: gyoutube
plugins.description: YouTube Data, YouTube Analytics and YouTube Reporting APIs, plus Blogger.

plugins.name: gbusiness
plugins.description: Business Profile accounts, locations, verifications, lodging, place actions, notifications and performance.

plugins.name: gads
plugins.description: Google Ads API (accounts, campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, budgets, conversions, assets and GAQL reporting, with every other method through the gateway), plus advertising and publisher APIs: Search Ads 360, Display & Video 360, Campaign Manager, Ad Exchange, AdSense, AdMob, Real-time Bidding and more.

plugins.name: gmerchant
plugins.description: Merchant Center: Merchant API and Comparison Shopping Service, through a service account key.

plugins.name: gplay
plugins.description: Google Play developer publishing and reporting, Play Games Services, Android Enterprise and Management, Play Integrity and device APIs.

plugins.name: gfirebase
plugins.description: Firebase management, App Check, App Distribution, Crashlytics, Hosting, Data Connect, Rules, Test Lab, FCM and Identity Toolkit.

plugins.name: gmaps
plugins.description: Maps Platform and location APIs: Places, Address Validation, Solar, Air Quality, Pollen, Street View Publish and related datasets.

plugins.name: gai
plugins.description: Generative and classic AI APIs: Discovery Engine, Vertex AI, Dialogflow, Vision, Speech, Translate, Document AI and agent services.
